mapper.sql: m.id, m.agent_id, m.merchant_name, m.merchant_code, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.address, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time, a.agent_name as agent_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchants m LEFT JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM merchants m LEFT JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.merchant_code = #{merchantCode}
SELECT FROM merchants m LEFT JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchants WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants (agent_id, merchant_name, merchant_code, contact_name, contact_phone, address, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantCode}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET agent_id = #{agentId}, merchant_name = #{merchantName}, merchant_code = #{merchantCode}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
